notFound: Paravel: paravel.com is password-locked (Shopify password page) on 2026-10-04. The brand closed after its 2025 Chapter 7 filing and ATR Group (Antler) has announced a relaunch with sales from 8 Oct 2026 (Business of Fashion, TheStreet). Nothing is currently sold, so no Paravel products are listed.

Osprey: osprey.com returned 403 to every request (US, GB, CA paths; curl and WebFetch). Osprey products come from Ramsey Outdoor (US, Shopify) and Trailhead Paddle Shack (Canada, Shopify) and are marked secondhand. Colours are only the ones those retailers stock. No UK, Ireland or Mexico offers. Not found or not in stock at those retailers: Farpoint Trek / Fairview Trek, Transporter wheeled range, Ozone wheeled luggage (Ozone 2-Wheel Carry-On 40 was sold out in Canada), Fairview 55 in the US.

Patagonia: patagonia.com, patagonia.ca and eu.patagonia.com served a bot-block/maintenance page to curl and WebFetch. Black Hole products come from Patagonia Bend (authorized dealer, Shopify), marked secondhand. Colours are the dealer's stock, not Patagonia's full range. No UK, Ireland, Canada or Mexico offers. Black Hole Pack 25L/32L were left out as daypacks.

The North Face: thenorthface.com returned 403 in every region. Its luggage figures come only from search-engine excerpts of thenorthface.com pages, marked secondhand. Colour lists were not read except Rolling Thunder TNF Black. Not found: Base Camp Duffel XL/XXL dimensions and weights, and Base Camp Voyager dimensions, weights and the Travel Pack's litres. Only the Voyager duffels had UK, Ireland and Canada prices.

July: there is no Ireland or Mexico storefront (july.com/ie and /mx redirect to 404). july.com/eu showed GBP prices, so it was not used for Ireland. Carry On Max is not on the UK store. Carry On Light (non-expandable) and Checked Light appear only on the UK store. The bag pages publish no outside dimensions, so outsideCm is null for July bags.

BÉIS: no Mexico storefront was found (mx.beistravel.com does not resolve). Ireland prices come from eu.beistravel.com, whose country list includes Ireland. Most duffel, weekender and backpack pages publish no dimensions or weight in fetchable form (specs load client-side), so those fields are null. Roller specs come from BÉIS's own carry-on and check-in comparison guides and product FAQs.

NOMATIC: UK, Ireland and Canada prices are the store's own Shopify market prices (converted from USD) read with a localization cookie. With Mexico selected the store still shows USD, so there is no MXN offer.

Peak Design: no Ireland or Mexico storefront (/en-ie and Mexico fall back to the US store in USD). Travel Duffelpack 65L dimensions and weight were not on the page. 'Marketplace' certified-used and factory-second listings were left out.

Eagle Creek: eaglecreek.com sells internationally only in USD (no local-currency market for UK, IE, CA or MX), so only US offers are listed. Discontinued listings (marked '(Discontinued)'), bundles and totes were left out.

Thule: per-colour stock was not reliably readable, so variants list every colour the US store links to. Mexico pages 404 for the EnRoute and Subterra 2 luggage. The US price of Subterra 2 Widebody Carry-On Spinner read as 0 (unlisted) and Canada's also as 0, so only UK and IE offers are given. Where a family carried two model numbers (e.g. TSRS422 vs TSRS522), each is listed as its own product.

warrantyYears is null throughout: these brands give lifetime or limited-lifetime warranties (BÉIS Limited Lifetime, NOMATIC Life Well Lived, Peak Design Lifetime, Eagle Creek No Matter What, July Lifetime, Osprey All Mighty Guarantee), which are not a number of years.
outsideCm is given as the published three dimensions sorted largest to smallest (taken as height, width, depth), converted from inches where the maker published inches.
